raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "intend to attend"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the parents' evening"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?how
  where match
    relation "commute by"
    role subject "Amira"
    role instrument ?how
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  select ?place
  where match
    relation "take place at"
    role subject "the town hall debate"
    role location ?place
    polarity affirmed
  end
